text:
alec: FYI I opened a small PR to clarify SOC2/audit export wording and add concrete examples for TTL vs legal hold + a compact Go SDK snippet and a curl one-liner. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9901 :memo:

nina: nice—do we avoid the vague "may retain" language? auditors flagged that before.

alec: yes, replaced with: "Redwood retains audit logs per the customer's configured retention policy (TTL) or an active legal hold." added link to the retention page and an example export header.

docs-bot: PR #9901 - link checks: docs/compliance/retention-policy -> 404.

nina: ah that page name changed last sprint. canonical is /docs/compliance/retention-overview, please point there.

alec: will update. also tightened snippet error handling per docs style (no log.Fatal, short snippets).

ops: can we include the exact header format the export sets? our ingestion pipeline expects a predictable header.

alec: added header example and a tiny JSON header + Go + curl examples. kept the header to a single line so log parsers like it.

---
Example export response header (illustrative):

X-Redwood-Export-Retention: ttl=90d
X-Redwood-Export-Retention: legal_hold=true

Compact Go SDK snippet (7 lines):
```go
ctx := context.Background()
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
opts := &redwood.ExportOptions{TenantID: "t_abc", Format: "jsonl", Filters: []string{"event=auth"}, RetentionMode: "legal_hold"}
resp, err := client.Audit.Export(ctx, opts)
if err != nil { return err }
defer resp.Body.Close()
```

curl one-liner to trigger legal-hold export:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant_id=t_abc&format=jsonl&retention_mode=legal_hold" \
  -o t_abc-audit.jsonl
```
---

legal: suggested tweak: replace "Redwood retains" with "Redwood retains audit logs according to the customer's configured retention policy (TTL) or an active legal hold; see the retention overview." avoids implying unilateral retention windows.

alec: updated wording and swapped the link to /docs/compliance/retention-overview. force-pushed.

docs-bot: PR #9901 - link checks passed. spellcheck: passed. shortcode lint: warning about emoji shortcode in PR title (non-blocking).

nina: LGTM pending ops sanity check on header format.

ops: header looks good. approved.

nina: merging after docs-bot green and CI. thanks @alec and legal. :tada:
